$comment: Machine-readable contract details that OpenAPI does not carry well. Companion to /openapi/v1.json (snapshot: docs/openapi/v1.json). All enums travel as integers.

notificationTypes.name: AnnouncementPosted
notificationTypes.recipient: Group members except the author; for a company-wide announcement (audience 2), every pilgrim in the company's groups
notificationTypes.groupId: group id, or null for a company-wide announcement

notificationTypes.name: SupervisorActivated
notificationTypes.recipient: Company account (a supervisor was assigned or replaced on a group)

notificationTypes.name: GroupWithoutSupervisor
notificationTypes.recipient: Company account (first pilgrim added to a group that has no supervisor; once per group)

notificationTypes.name: GatheringPointChanged
notificationTypes.recipient: Group members except whoever changed it

notificationTypes.name: GroupMessagePosted
notificationTypes.recipient: Group members except the sender, when a pilgrim writes in the group chat
notificationTypes.preview: message text, or null for a location message without a caption

notificationTypes.name: SupervisorMessagePosted
notificationTypes.recipient: Group pilgrims, when the group supervisor writes in the group chat (will also be used for 1:1 supervisor messages once direct chat exists)
notificationTypes.preview: message text, or null for a location message without a caption

notificationTypes.name: EmergencyReported
notificationTypes.recipient: Supervisors of every group the pilgrim belongs to

notificationTypes.name: LostChildReported
notificationTypes.recipient: Supervisors of the reporter; with shareWithNearby also every user sharing a fresh location (< 15 min) within 1 km

pilgrimNotificationScreen.$comment: The four types on the pilgrim notifications screen.

signalR.authentication: Pass the JWT access token in the query string: ?access_token=<accessToken> (WebSockets cannot send an Authorization header).
signalR.subscriptions: Taken at connect time only: the connection joins every group the user is in (both hubs) and every family circle the user is in (/hubs/location). Reconnect after joining a group or circle, after a token refresh, or when /home reports a different group.
signalR.delivery: Best effort. Data is saved before it is pushed; re-fetch over REST after reconnecting.

clientToServer.behavior: Same as POST /location: location sharing must be on (PUT /location/sharing).
clientToServer.errors: HubException whose message starts with the error code, e.g. "Location.SharingDisabled: ..."; shape errors start with "Validation:".

serverToClient.audience: Members of the sender's groups, and members of each family circle where the sender shows their location
serverToClient.note: May arrive twice when the sender shares both a group and a circle with you; de-duplicate on userId + updatedAtUtc.
Sent when global sharing is turned off (all groups and circles), when sharing is turned off in one circle, or when a sharer leaves or is removed from a circle.

serverToClient.payload: ChatMessageDto (components.schemas.ChatMessageDto); isRead is always false in pushes
serverToClient.audience: Every connected member of the group, including the sender
serverToClient.note: Messages are sent over REST (POST /groups/{groupId}/messages); de-duplicate on id.

serverToClient.audience: The recipient only (resolved from the token's sub claim)

roles.$comment: Values in AuthTokens.user.roles and GET /auth/me roles. Role changes apply from the next token (refresh).

enumSemantics.CompanyStatus: Computed, never sent: 2 Stopped if an admin stopped the company, else 3 Expired if contractEndDate is before today (UTC), else 1 Active.
enumSemantics.TripStatus: Computed: 2 Departed once today (UTC) >= departureDate, else 1 Upcoming.
enumSemantics.AttendanceStatus: Pilgrims start at 2 Absent; POST .../attendance/confirm sets 1 Present; POST .../attendance/reset sets everyone back to 2.
enumSemantics.GroupMemberRole: 1 Leader is the group supervisor (at most one); 2 Member is a pilgrim.
enumSemantics.ChatMessageKind: 1 Text: body required (<= 2000). 2 Location: latitude and longitude required, body is an optional caption and comes back as "" when absent.
enumSemantics.AnnouncementAudience: 1 Group (posted by the group supervisor); 2 AllCompanyPilgrims (posted by the company, groupId is null).
enumSemantics.AnnouncementImportance: Defaults to 1 Normal when omitted; 2 shows the "important" badge.
enumSemantics.MapPlaceType: facilityKind is set only for 3 Facility; gates have it null.
enumSemantics.JourneyStatus: PUT /journeys/{id} is allowed only in 1 Draft or 2 Ready (409 otherwise).
enumSemantics.LostChildReportStatus: Only the reporter can move it to 2 Found.
enumSemantics.EmergencyStatus: The reporter or one of their supervisors can move it to 2 Resolved.

conventions.date: yyyy-MM-dd (DateOnly) for departureDate, returnDate, contractStartDate, contractEndDate, itinerary day date, departureDate in supervisor groups.

paging.nextPage: before = oldest createdAtUtc / sentAtUtc of the current page

conventions.password: At least 8 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a digit and a symbol.

errors.shape: application/problem+json (components.schemas.ProblemDetails): type, title, status, instance, traceId, and code on business errors.
errors.validation: 422 (components.schemas.HttpValidationProblemDetails): errors maps camelCase JSON paths (fullName, arrival.entryPoint, stays[0].placeName) to messages; no code.
errors.branchOn: code (stable, Area.Reason); fall back to status. title is English, for logs.
